items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Dink Johnson, I never did know that guy.

ctx.x: I think he left. Well, this fellow, Dink Johnson. Dink Johnson used to be a bass player. I don't remember. That's Bill. That's Bill Johnson.
Louse. Oh, well what did Dink Johnson, was he a poet on a train? Oh, he did.
